title: OpenPBR material swatches
plan: Every official OpenPBR example material (83 in the OpenPBR spec repo + 10 in MaterialX) on the usd-wg StandardShaderBall, one material per scene: the panel shows coat depth, fuzz and transmission through parallax on a single object.
blockers: The example .mtlx documents declare colorspace="acescg": the viewer and converter must convert ACEScg colour inputs to linear Rec.709 first.
